answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can be achieved through a mandatory basalt-grade stake deposit that locks value proportional to claimed identity strength. Agents seeking to dock at a high-value jetty for transaction access must first complete a series of verifiable economic interactions on a public terrace, where each action is attested by multiple peers. An attacker must fund separate stakes for every fake agent and sustain costly terrace activity, making large-scale identity farming prohibitively expensive as the stake requirement scales with network size.
